# Taipa UI

Taipa UI is a direct-DOM islands framework for server-authored HTML.

Documentation: https://taipa-ui.dev/
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@taipa/ui
Source: https://github.com/raisiqueira/taipa

Key topics: server rendering, client hydration, progressive forms, Standard Schema validation, no-build delivery, and the public markup contract.
